scheme_name: Matru Jyothi - Financial Assistance For PwD Mothers
other_conditions: Applicant must be a native and resident of Kerala
Applicant must be a mother with a child younger than two years
Applicant must have a disability of one of the listed types with the specified minimum disability percentage (e.g., blindness ≥ 80 %, intellectual disability ≥ 60 %, etc.)
benefits_summary: Financial assistance of ₹2,000 paid to differently‑abled mothers until their child turns two years old.
